description.value: High Tide Public House is a seafood-centric pub in the heart of downtown Courtenay on Vancouver Island, known for its homemade menu featuring local ingredients like Fanny Bay oysters and island mussels alongside craft cocktails and BC beers on tap. The venue hosts regular live entertainment including open mic comedy nights and music events, making it a lively community gathering spot in the Comox Valley. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down restaurant experience with takeout and delivery options also available.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces) at 77m; rack (4 spaces) at 91m; bollard at 94m. Total: 8 spaces.
